name: AK23BH - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR & Electrochemical Sensors, Big-Digit Display
highlights: The AK23B With Report-Grade Sensing — The big-digit face kept exactly as it is, with infrared NDIR CO₂ and an electrochemical formaldehyde cell underneath. Long-distance legibility and report-grade numbers in one device.
The Top Configuration of the AK23 Enclosure — Nothing above it in this body: upgraded sensing, full particulate split, clean buttonless front.
Grouped Value Layout — Gases, particulates and climate arranged as labelled groups around a single dominant figure.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour USB-C charge, 256 g.
32 Per Carton — 500 × 261 × 302 mm outer carton, 14.05 kg gross.
